b9678fc2acca0f5a.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع جداول زمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على التعامل مع وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة والصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل تتمركز هذه الوظيفة في مدينة حائل، وهي وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مجموعة الذيابي للمقاولات. يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة العمل بفعالية ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

b91f53408b98fc4a.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Senior Façade Engineer (Specialist) to join our team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. The successful candidate will ensure the successful integration of architectural vision, structural performance, sustainability objectives, and construction requirements into high-quality façade systems. Key Responsibilities The Senior Façade Engineer will provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle, overseeing various aspects of façade development and delivery: Lead the design and engineering of building façade systems, including curtain walls, cladding systems, skylights, roofing interfaces, glazing systems, architectural metalwork, and specialty façade elements. Develop façade design concepts, specifications, calculations, and technical reports. Perform façade performance assessments related to structural integrity, thermal performance, acoustic performance, weatherproofing, fire safety, and sustainability requirements. Review and approve façade shop drawings, material submissions, mock-ups, and engineering calculations. Ensure façade solutions meet architectural intent while maintaining constructability, durability, and lifecycle performance. Technical Coordination and Design Management Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, contractors, and specialist façade consultants. Manage design interfaces between façade systems and surrounding building elements. Conduct technical design reviews and identify opportunities for value engineering and optimization. Support BIM coordination and multidisciplinary integration throughout the design process. Review design proposals for compliance with project specifications, international standards, and local authority requirements. Construction Support and Site Supervision Provide technical support during procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning phases. Monitor façade installation activities to ensure compliance with approved designs and quality requirements. Review testing protocols and witness performance testing, including air infiltration, water penetration, structural loading, and mock-up testing. Resolve technical issues arising during fabrication and construction. Support project teams during inspections, handover, and defect rectification stages. Stakeholder Management and Commercial Oversight Act as the primary façade engineering representative for clients and project stakeholders. Participate in design workshops, technical meetings, and coordination reviews. Prepare technical reports, presentations, and engineering recommendations. Establish and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, suppliers, and specialist consultants. Provide technical advice regarding façade technologies, materials, and best practices. Support cost planning and procurement strategies for façade packages. Identify technical and project risks associated with façade systems and implement mitigation measures. Review contractor claims, variations, and technical change requests. Ensure compliance with project governance procedures and contractual requirements. Contribute to bid evaluations and contractor selection processes. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess the following: A minimum of 10 years of experience in façade engineering. Demonstrated ability to promote sustainable façade design solutions that improve energy efficiency and environmental performance. Experience ensuring compliance with sustainability frameworks, energy codes, and green building certification requirements. A commitment to maintaining high standards of quality assurance and technical excellence. A proactive approach to innovation through the adoption of emerging façade technologies, digital engineering tools, and advanced materials.

b97fd2dfb39534cb.description: About Ninja Ninja is looking for an experienced Energy and Utilities Specialist to manage and optimize electricity and water consumption across its stores and facilities. The role will focus on improving energy efficiency, monitoring utility performance, implementing engineering improvements, and delivering measurable cost savings through energy audits and IoT-enabled solutions. Key Responsibilities Monitor electricity and water consumption, establish baselines, and track utility costs across stores. Conduct energy audits and identify high-consumption locations and energy losses. Identify and coordinate energy-efficiency improvements across HVAC, refrigeration, lighting, insulation, and operational systems. Support the installation, configuration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of IoT energy meters, sensors, and LoRaWAN gateways. Coordinate utility meter mapping, invoice validation, and consumption discrepancy investigations. Evaluate energy-saving projects and prepare technical and financial assessments, including estimated savings and payback periods. Track and validate energy savings against approved baselines. Prepare monthly dashboards and reports on energy consumption and performance. Collaborate with Maintenance, Operations, Procurement, and Technology teams. Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. 3–5 years of relevant experience in energy management, utility monitoring, or energy auditing. Hands-on experience with IoT devices, including LoRaWAN gateways, sensors, commissioning, and troubleshooting. Strong knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, refrigeration, and energy-efficient controls. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables and Power Query. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience in multisite retail, supermarkets, warehouses, or cold-chain operations is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Power BI experience. Familiarity with MQTT, Modbus, BACnet, and monitoring-platform integration. Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Certified Energy Auditor (CEA), or equivalent certification.

b9a85b32272b6d4b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيجا للحلول الهندسية عن مهندس كهربائي سعودي للانضمام إلى فريق حلول توليد الطاقة في مدينة الرياض. يستهدف هذا الدور خريجي الجامعات السعودية الحاصلين على درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية، بحد أقصى سنتين من الخبرة. مجال عمل الشركة تعمل شركة فيجا للحلول الهندسية في مجال حلول توليد الطاقة والطاقة الكهربائية. يشمل نطاق عمل الشركة مولدات الديزل، أنظمة التحويل التلقائي (ATS) والمزامنة، أنظمة الوقود، خدمات الاختبار والتشغيل، الصيانة، وتقديم الحلول الهندسية المتكاملة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير ومتابعة فرص المبيعات والمشاريع. التواصل مع العملاء لفهم متطلباتهم الفنية والتجارية. إعداد ومتابعة العروض الفنية والتجارية. دعم العملاء في اختيار حلول المولدات وأنظمة الطاقة المناسبة. التنسيق مع فريق التطبيقات والهندسة والموردين. زيارة العملاء والمشاريع ومتابعة الفرص. المساهمة في تقديم الحلول الفنية والتجارية المناسبة للعملاء. تطوير علاقات مهنية مع المقاولين والاستشاريين والمستخدمين النهائيين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية من جامعة سعودية. خبرة تتراوح من حديث التخرج حتى سنتين في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التواصل الفعال وفهم المتطلبات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد العروض الفنية والتجارية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس ضمن فريق حلول توليد الطاقة في مدينة الرياض، في وظيفة بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور زيارات ميدانية للعملاء والمشاريع. التقديم هذه فرصة للمهندسين الكهربائيين السعوديين للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص والمساهمة في تقديم حلول هندسية متكاملة في قطاع الطاقة.

b9e863691e38d887.description: About the role This is an entry-level web development role inside a strategy advisory firm, and it exists because the firm's own web presence and internal tools are worked on by people who also have client mandates to run. You would carry the day-to-day build and upkeep of those properties from your first week: the site, the pages we publish for the markets we work in, and the small internal tools that principals and analysts use to get their work done. The scope is practical rather than theoretical, and you would own finished work rather than fragments of someone else's project. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm based in Riyadh, working mostly with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that have significant interests there. We advise family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. The work covers corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. Engagements are scoped by the principals who then deliver them, and they often continue past the recommendation into board meetings and the testing of management plans. What you will do Build and maintain the firm's public website, including new pages, content updates, and the fixes that keep a live site working properly. Turn material from principals into clean, readable web pages and documents, matching the firm's own tone rather than a template. Maintain the small internal tools the team relies on, such as a dashboard of live engagements or a shared library of published research. Test pages across browsers and screen sizes, and resolve layout and performance issues as they come up. Write down what you built and how it is maintained, so the next person can pick it up without asking you. Work with whoever is scoping a piece of the site, ask what the page needs to do, and come back with something that does it. What we need from you Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, whether from a degree, a course, or projects you built yourself. Some experience with a modern framework or content management system, and a clear account of what you did in it. Care for how a page reads as well as how it renders: spacing, hierarchy, and text that a client can follow. Comfort working from a short written brief, and asking questions early when the brief is thin. Written and spoken English at a professional level. Arabic is useful for reviewing content, but not required. An interest in how organizations in the Kingdom actually operate, since the site speaks to the people we advise. What success looks like Within six to twelve months, the site should be something principals can point a client to without checking it first. Requests for a new page or a correction should reach you and come back done, without a chase. The internal tools should be used daily by people who would notice if they stopped working. You would also have a record of a few things you fixed that no one asked about, because you saw them and dealt with them. How decisions get made Principals scope the work and decide what the firm publishes, so you would get a brief rather than a ticket queue. You own the build, the sequence of it, and the technical choices inside it, and you would be expected to say when a request will take longer than the person asking assumes. Anything that touches how the firm presents itself to a client goes to the principal who owns that relationship. Escalation is direct: you raise it with the person who scoped it, and if that stalls, it goes to a partner. What the role offers This is a permanent, full-time position, hybrid, based in Riyadh. You would see how an advisory firm presents its thinking to boards and management teams, and how that thinking changes once a decision is made. The web work is real and it is used, and the people reviewing it read closely. You would work alongside principals and analysts rather than in a separate technology function. Who tends to do well here People who write clearly and would rather cut a paragraph than add one. People who can work in a client's own vocabulary without needing a formal specification to begin. People who are comfortable being accountable for a number, a deadline, or a page that has to be right when a principal sends the link. The role suits someone early in their career who wants to see the decision behind the work, not only the ticket in front of them.

وتوليد فرص مبيعات مؤهلة في المملكة العربية السعودية. سيجمع شاغل الوظيفة بين تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية محليًا والبحث عن العملاء المحتملين وتطوير العلاقات وتأهيل الفرص، بالتعاون الوثيق مع فرق المبيعات والتسويق والفرق الفنية. الغرض من الوظيفة يتمثل الهدف الأساسي لهذا الدور في تحويل اهتمام السوق إلى محادثات مؤهلة مع العملاء ومسار مبيعات قابل للقياس. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق على تحديد صانعي القرار في القطاعات المستهدفة والتواصل معهم، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ الحملات التسويقية وتنسيق الفعاليات لتعزيز فرص المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قائمة مرتبة حسب الأولوية بالحسابات المستهدفة وتحديثها باستمرار في قطاعات النفط والغاز، والبتروكيماويات، والطاقة والمرافق، والأسمنت، والتعدين، والتصنيع الصناعي. تحديد صانعي القرار في مجالات التحول الرقمي، والعمليات، والصيانة، والموثوقية، والهندسة، وتقنية المعلومات، والمشتريات، والتواصل معهم عبر LinkedIn والبريد الإلكتروني والاتصال الهاتفي والشبكات المهنية. تأهيل العملاء المحتملين الواردين والمستهدفين بالتواصل المباشر والقادمين عبر الشركاء والفعاليات، من خلال فهم التحدي الذي يواجهه العميل، ومدى ملاءمة الحساب، وأصحاب المصلحة، وأولويات المشاريع، والتوقيت المتوقع. ترتيب اجتماعات استكشافية وعروض توضيحية بالتنسيق مع فرق المبيعات والفرق الفنية. تنفيذ الحملات المحلية والندوات الإلكترونية والمعارض وورش عمل العملاء وفعاليات الشركاء بدعم من إدارة التسويق المركزية. تكييف العروض التقديمية ودراسات الحالة ورسائل الحملات المعتمدة بما يتناسب مع السوق السعودي. تنسيق الاجتماعات قبل المؤتمرات، وتسجيل جميع العملاء المحتملين من الفعاليات في نظام إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM)، وبدء متابعة مخصّصة خلال يومي عمل. الاستمرار في المتابعة إلى أن تتحدد لكل عميل محتمل خطوة تالية واضحة أو يُصنَّف ضمن مرحلة الرعاية. بناء العلاقات مع شركات تكامل الأنظمة والشركات الهندسية وشركاء التقنية لدعم التعارف مع العملاء والفعاليات المشتركة وتوليد العملاء المحتملين. الحفاظ على دقة السجلات في نظام CRM، بما يشمل مصدر العميل المحتمل، وملاحظات التأهيل، وبيانات أصحاب المصلحة، والمسؤول عن الحساب، والإجراءات التالية. تسليم العملاء المحتملين إلى فريق المبيعات بشكل واضح ومساعدته في الحفاظ على التواصل. إعداد التقارير عن الاجتماعات المؤهلة، والفرص التي قبلها فريق المبيعات، ومسار المبيعات المُولَّد، وأداء الحملات. مشاركة ملاحظات العملاء، والمعلومات عن المنافسين، واحتياجات السوق الناشئة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التسويق وتطوير الأعمال. القدرة على تحديد العملاء المحتملين وتأهيلهم. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لبناء العلاقات مع العملاء والشركاء. القدرة على العمل بشكل وثيق مع فرق المبيعات والتسويق والفرق الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق ديناميكي في شركة تقنيات الأعمال المتقدمة، ويتعاون مع الأقسام المختلفة لتحقيق أهداف الشركة في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية.

b9150b35b984d1b9.description: تعلن SeenCRM عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريق المبيعات، والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف الشركة من خلال استقطاب العملاء، بناء العلاقات التجارية، وتحويل الفرص إلى مبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات: البحث عن العملاء المحتملين واستقطاب فرص مبيعات جديدة. التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين عبر الهاتف، البريد الإلكتروني، ووسائل التواصل المناسبة. فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم الحلول والخدمات المناسبة من SeenCRM. تقديم عروض المنتجات والخدمات وشرح القيمة المضافة للعملاء. متابعة العملاء المحتملين وتحويل الفرص إلى صفقات ناجحة. إدارة دورة المبيعات من مرحلة التواصل الأولي وحتى إغلاق الصفقة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء والمحافظة عليها. تحديث بيانات العملاء والفرص والملاحظات بشكل مستمر على نظام CRM. تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والأهداف المحددة من الإدارة. إعداد ومتابعة عروض الأسعار والتفاوض مع العملاء ضمن الصلاحيات المعتمدة. متابعة السوق والمنافسين وتحديد فرص النمو الجديدة. التنسيق مع فرق التشغيل وخدمة العملاء لضمان انتقال سلس للعملاء بعد إتمام البيع. إعداد تقارير دورية عن أنشطة المبيعات، الفرص، والنتائج. المتطلبات: خبرة سابقة في المبيعات، ويفضل في مجال التقنية أو البرمجيات أو حلول الأعمال. مهارات قوية في التواصل والتفاوض والإقناع. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية مع العملاء. القدرة على العمل وفق أهداف ومؤشرات أداء واضحة. مهارات جيدة في استخدام أنظمة CRM وأدوات المبيعات. المبادرة والقدرة على البحث عن فرص جديدة وتطوير قاعدة العملاء. إجادة اللغة العربية، ويفضل إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية. للتقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع كتابة Sales Specialist في عنوان البريد الإلكتروني. i@**************

b930b598309ab62b.description: About the Role Yamama Cement is seeking a Senior Mechanic to join their team. This full-time position involves performing essential mechanical maintenance tasks to ensure the efficient operation of production units. The role requires adherence to established policies and safety procedures, contributing to the overall reliability and performance of equipment. Key Responsibilities Execute routine, preventive, and emergency mechanical maintenance in accordance with approved policies and procedures. Monitor the performance of production units to ensure operation within designated limits and report any observations affecting equipment efficiency. Identify necessary maintenance tools and equipment, assess their readiness, and perform preventive maintenance to ensure continuous availability. Organize and store maintenance tools in designated locations, maintain them properly, and ensure appropriate disposal of maintenance waste. Perform mechanical repair work, including welding, cutting, and refurbishing replaced parts to ensure their readiness and efficiency. Comply with all safety procedures before commencing work, including verifying required permits and lockout/tagout forms. Undertake any other tasks assigned by the direct supervisor. Work Type This is a full-time position, requiring dedicated presence to manage and execute mechanical maintenance operations within the company's facilities. Application Process Candidates interested in the Senior Mechanic position at Yamama Cement are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application submission will be provided upon inquiry.

b9560627fccdef62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سرعه التعمير للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في أملج، تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والإصلاح للمشاريع والمباني والمجمعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال إدارة الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة وتقدير كمية المواد اللازمة لكل مهمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج العمل والتقارير المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في إدارة أعمال الصيانة والتشغيل والإصلاح للمشاريع والمباني والمجمعات. خبرة في برامج وإجراءات الصيانة المبرمجة. القدرة على تنظيم وتخطيط العمليات اليومية وأعمال الصيانة الوقائية قصيرة وطويلة المدى. معرفة واطلاع على الأعمال الفنية التي تخدم أغراض صيانة المباني، مثل: الدهان، السباكة، الطرق، الأرضيات، والأعمال الزراعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في أملج، تبوك، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على الكفاءة والجودة في أعمال الصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b95c3f9934d9cdce.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حسام بن سعد بن حسين الحارثي للصرافه عن صراف عملات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة للعمل بدوام كامل في قطاع الصرافة، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة وإدارة عمليات صرف العملات بدقة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية شراء وبيع العملات الأجنبية وفقاً للأسعار المحددة. التأكد من صحة الأوراق النقدية باستخدام الأجهزة المخصصة لذلك. تقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة والتعامل مع استفسارات العملاء بمهنية. متابعة أسعار الصرف اليومية وتنفيذ العمليات المالية بدقة عالية. المحافظة على سرية المعلومات والالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات الداخلية والخارجية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الأجهزة المخصصة للكشف عن العملات. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في التعامل مع العمليات المالية. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. الالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات المتعلقة بالصرافة. القدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الصراف ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة عمل منظمة تلتزم بأعلى معايير الدقة والسرية في التعاملات المالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

b96958497c33d2fd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايمان للتوكيلات والتجاره والمقاولات عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية وتشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة أنشطة الصيانة لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بحسب البرامج المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية بدقة. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير تكاليف المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة ايمان للتوكيلات والتجاره والمقاولات. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير، وهو متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل ملتزم في شركة ايمان للتوكيلات والتجاره والمقاولات. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b981a36e0718d459.description: Overview As a Product Manager at Four Principles, you will own the vision, backlog, and delivery of the digital products we build for our clients across government, semi-government, and private sectors. You will be the bridge between client stakeholders and our delivery team, making sure that what gets built solves the right problem. Working closely with solution architects, UI/UX designers, developers, and QA engineers, you will turn business needs into a clear, prioritized backlog and guide each release from discovery to adoption, ensuring every increment delivers measurable value to the client. Key Responsibilities Define and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and release plan in line with the client's strategic and digital transformation objectives. Own, refine, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user needs, risk, and technical dependencies. Translate business requirements into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the delivery team can estimate and build. Act as the main point of contact between client stakeholders and the delivery team, running workshops, demos, and steering updates. Lead Agile ceremonies with the Scrum Master, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Work with the Solution Architect and UI/UX Designer to ensure solutions are feasible, user-centered, and aligned with architecture standards. Define product KPIs and success metrics, track them after go-live, and use the data to drive the next round of improvements. Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and accept or reject completed work against agreed acceptance criteria. Manage scope, timelines, and trade-offs, escalating risks and dependencies early with clear options and recommendations. Produce and maintain product documentation, including requirements, release notes, and user guides, to support handover and adoption. Contribute to FP's proposals and pre-sales work by shaping digital product scope, estimates, and delivery approaches. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in digital product delivery, with at least 3 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager on web or mobile platforms. Proven experience owning a product backlog and writing user stories and acceptance criteria within Agile/Scrum teams. Experience working directly with senior client or business stakeholders and managing competing priorities. Hands-on experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar backlog tools, plus Confluence and Figma or equivalent. Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and system integrations, enough to discuss trade-offs with engineers. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to present to both technical and non-technical audiences.

b9199ec0db926e25.description: About the Role H&P is seeking a Security Supervisor to manage security personnel, activities, and contractors across its operations in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, and is critical for ensuring the security of H&P assets and operations. Role Context and Scope The Security Supervisor will provide day-to-day management of security operations supporting H&P business initiatives. This includes oversight of the Dammam Base, Bahrain Camp, stack yards, housing compounds, and other locations where H&P has security exposure. The role involves close collaboration with local H&P personnel to ensure necessary security support is provided to stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Manage security personnel, activities, and contractors across H&P locations in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. Oversee security operations at the Dammam Base, Bahrain Camp, stack yards, and housing compounds. Manage and maintain the CCTV system, access control system, and other physical security equipment. Develop and implement security programs aimed at securing H&P assets in the field. Collaborate with local H&P personnel to ensure security support aligns with operational needs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in security management or a related field. Demonstrated experience in managing security personnel and contractors. Proficiency in overseeing physical security systems, including CCTV and access control. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern Region, with responsibilities extending to various H&P sites in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The Security Supervisor will operate in a dynamic environment, ensuring the safety and security of company assets and personnel across multiple locations. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b94654df98c0e72c.description: About the Role The Legal Advisor provides comprehensive legal support and advisory services to Integrated Solution Group units. This full-time role involves reviewing, drafting, and negotiating contracts and agreements, offering legal consultations throughout project lifecycles, and ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The advisor is responsible for protecting the company’s legal interests while supporting business growth and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Provide legal opinions, advice, and guidance on legal, commercial, and operational matters to business units. Interpret applicable laws, regulations, and requirements impacting projects and services. Draft, review, amend, and negotiate various legal documents, including contracts, agreements, MoUs, NDAs, and partnership agreements. Ensure contracts adequately protect the company’s rights and interests, identifying legal gaps, liabilities, and obligations. Offer legal support for projects, services, and digital initiatives across their entire lifecycle, reviewing new projects and business models from a legal and regulatory perspective. Monitor applicable laws, regulations, policies, and regulatory developments, assessing their impact on business operations. Identify, assess, and mitigate legal risks associated with contracts, operations, projects, and partnerships. Support corporate legal matters related to commercial activities and strategic transactions, including partnership arrangements and due diligence. Assist in handling disputes, claims, litigation matters, and legal proceedings, coordinating with external legal advisors as required. Develop and maintain legal templates, standards, and contract repositories, ensuring proper record management of legal documentation. Compliance and Documentation Ensure alignment with internal governance frameworks and regulatory obligations. Comply with all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Adhere to all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies and controls. Comply with information security practices and standards to maintain data integrity and confidentiality. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in legal advisory and support roles, demonstrating a strong understanding of contract law, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

b9512ccb86aa2ebb.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking an Assistant Consultant - Family Medicine to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive primary healthcare to individuals and families of all ages, both physically and through telemedicine. The Assistant Consultant will focus on preventive, acute, and chronic care, playing a key role in diagnosing and treating medical conditions, promoting health education, and coordinating care with specialists. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive telehealth and in-person consultations, including thorough patient history and physical examinations for general medicine complaints. Provide healthcare to the family medicine target population across all ages and genders. Offer chronic disease and preventive care consultations and follow-ups in accordance with clinical guidelines. Utilize video conferencing platforms for symptom assessment, medical history review, and virtual examinations. Develop personalized treatment plans, prescribe medications, and provide ongoing patient education. Oversee ongoing care for chronic and acute conditions, adjusting treatment plans based on patient feedback and clinical outcomes. Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure seamless patient care. Practice population health management by identifying and addressing health issues, implementing preventive measures, and promoting health education. Document findings and treatment plans meticulously in patient records. Quality Assurance and Compliance Communicate effectively with patients and families, providing clear explanations of diagnoses, treatment options, and follow-up care. Adhere to all relevant medical regulations, ethical guidelines, and quality assurance standards for both telehealth and in-person practice. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of telehealth regulations and best practices. Participate in quality improvement initiatives, research activities, and clinical audits. Regularly review compliance protocols and participate in training sessions. Professional Development Continuously enhance professional knowledge and skills in family medicine, in-person care, and telehealth best practices. Attend relevant conferences, workshops, and online courses. Stay informed about advancements in family medicine and telehealth technology. Patient Safety and Satisfaction Maintain compliance with all patient safety standards across clinical interactions. Report any patient safety risks or issues to the quality department. Explain medication side effects and proper use to patients. Ensure satisfactory patient consultations through effective communication, complete history taking, empathy, and clear explanation of diagnoses and management plans. Monitor patient feedback and address concerns promptly. Collaboration and Platform Proficiency Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to optimize patient care and facilitate communication regarding patient status and needs. Maintain proficiency in utilizing the designated telehealth platform, including video conferencing, secure messaging, and electronic health records (EHR) integration. b9a9e952b2d63d81.description: مطلوب مدير علاقات عامة للعمل مع منصة وتطبيق رش رومز – ثورة التأجير والبيعنبحث عن مدير علاقات عامة محترف، ذكي، مبادر، ولديه قدرة عالية على بناء العلاقات وفتح الأبواب مع ذات التأثير.متابعة فرص الرعاية، التعاون، الاستثمار، والتكامل مع القطاعات المختلفة.تحسين صورة الشركة أمام الشركاء والمستخدمين والجهات الخارجية.إعداد تقارير دورية عن العلاقات والفرص المفتوحة ونتائج b9809e7f36641ff5.job_title: Manager-Internal Audit & Risk Management- Saudi Nationals
b9809e7f36641ff5.description: Aljomaih Energy and Water Company (AEW) develops, invests in, owns and operates conventional power generation, renewable power and water desalination assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider region largely through project-specific special purpose vehicles (SPVs) and joint ventures with domestic and international partners. The Internal Audit & Risk Management function provides independent and objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve AEW's operations. The function reports functionally to the Board Audit Committee and administratively to the Chief Executive Officer. This role supports the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management across corporate functions, project companies and joint venture entities and is expected to operate credibly with senior management, external auditors, regulators, lenders and shareholder representatives. Overview The Manager, Internal Audit & Risk Management plays a critical role in upholding AEW's ethical, governance and operational integrity. The role plans and executes risk-based internal audits, supports the design and operation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, and advises management on effective risk mitigation and control improvement. The role requires a proactive mindset, strong analytical and report-writing skills, sound judgement in sensitive situations and a working understanding of the utilities development industry - in particular conventional power, renewable power and water projects and the contractual and financing structures through which they are delivered. Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities) Internal Audit Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual risk-based internal audit plan and independently manage and execute internal audits engagement within your assigned area of responsibility. Evaluate & Improve: Conduct comprehensive audits of various business functions, processes and controls, evaluating their effectiveness and identifying areas for improvement. Compliance & Reporting: Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company policies, and prepare clear and concise audit reports that communicate findings, recommendations and remediation plans to senior management and the Board Audit Committee. Follow-up & Monitoring: Monitor and track the implementation of agreed-upon audit recommendations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of identified issues. Policies and Procedures Review: Assist in the review and improvement of company-wide policies, procedures, and management practices. Project, Contract and Capital Expenditure Audits Audit the project development lifecycle from origination and bid through to financial close, construction, commissioning and handover to operations. Contract Assurance: Review compliance with EPC, O&M, PPA/WPA, shareholder and financing agreements, including obligations, milestones, liquidated damages, warranties, insurance and reporting covenants. Capex & Claims: Verify progress payments, variation orders, claims, change management and contingency utilization against contractual entitlement and approved budgets. SPV & JV Governance: Assess governance, delegation of authority and control arrangements at project companies and joint ventures, including access rights available to AEW under shareholder agreements. Risk Management Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual plan to support, manage and execute risk management engagements within your assigned area of responsibility ERM Framework: Collaborate with the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management and senior management to develop, implement & maintain the company's ERM framework, encompassing risk identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring processes. Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and evaluate potential risks facing the company, considering likelihood, impact and cascading effects. Develop and implement effective risk mitigation plans aligned with the overall ERM strategy and internal controls framework. Risk Communication & Monitoring: Maintain an updated risk register and ensure consistent communication of risks to relevant stakeholders. Integrate risk management activities with internal audit processes. Emerging Risks: Analyze emerging risks and trends, proactively adapt the ERM framework and annual plans to address them. Advisory and Ad hoc Engagement Ensure the smooth and effective execution of all Ad hoc or advisory engagements once assigned within expected turnaround time and quality of deliverables. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA preferred. Eight to ten years of relevant professional experience, of which a minimum of four to five years in internal audit, risk management or external audit. Experience with a Big Four firm, leading professional services firm or similar industry is preferred. Demonstrated exposure to IPP/IWP structures, project SPVs, joint ventures, EPC and O&M contracts and project finance is strongly preferred. Track record of reporting to, or presenting at, an Audit Committee or equivalent governance forum. Certifications Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) required or actively pursuing with completion within an agreed timeframe. One or more of the following is preferred: SOCPA, CPA, ACCA, CRMA, CFE, CISA or PMP. ISO 31000 risk management training is an advantage. COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework (2013) and COSO Enterprise Risk Management - Integrating with Strategy and Performance (2017). Understanding of NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls, Saudi Companies Law, applicable corporate governance regulations, ZATCA requirements and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia.

b94909a223cdd7d2.description: About Side Side is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 15+ studios in over a dozen countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. About the role As a Technical Artist , you will serve as a bridge between the art and engineering teams, ensuring that our assets and tools meet both creative and technical requirements for AAA-quality games across PC, console, mobile, and VR/AR platforms. Your expertise will play a vital role in optimizing pipelines, solving complex technical challenges, and delivering world-class visuals. Please note, this listing is not for an immediate open position but for our Talent Pool for Co-Development Roles. By applying, you express interest in being considered for future project-based opportunities that align with your skills and experience. These opportunities are contingent on client needs and project availability. As projects are initiated or client proposals are developed, we will review candidates from this pool and contact those who most closely align with the specific requirements of the co-development opportunity. How We Keep You Engaged We maintain strong relationships with our talent pool by providing regular updates, industry insights, and information on upcoming opportunities. We will check in to confirm your availability and interest. Our hiring teams carefully vet and select top candidates who best meet project needs, ensuring that you are matched with the right opportunity when it becomes available. Next Steps If you are passionate about contributing to cutting-edge projects and want to be considered for future co-development opportunities, we encourage you to apply to this listing. While there may not be an immediate opening, your application ensures that you will be part of our ongoing talent review for upcoming roles. Only resumes submitted in English will be considered. Key Responsibilities Serve as a liaison between art and engineering teams, facilitating communication and solving technical challenges. Develop, optimize, and maintain pipelines and tools for art asset creation and integration. Collaborate with artists and engineers to ensure that assets meet performance, memory, and technical requirements across platforms. Debug and resolve technical issues related to shaders, rendering, and asset optimization. Implement and refine real-time visual effects, lighting setups, and material systems to achieve high-quality visuals. Provide technical support and training to artists, helping them leverage tools and workflows efficiently. Stay up to date with industry trends and technologies, incorporating innovative solutions into workflows. Document tools, pipelines, and best practices to ensure seamless onboarding and knowledge sharing within the team. Experience : 3+ years of experience as a Technical Artist in the video game industry. Demonstrated contribution to at least one shipped title on PC, console, mobile, or VR/AR. Technical Skills : Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, MEL, or MaxScript) and tools development. Strong understanding of shaders, rendering pipelines, and material creation in game engines like Unreal Engine or Unity. Experience with 3D modeling and texturing tools such as Maya, Blender, Substance Painter, or ZBrush. Knowledge of optimization techniques for performance across platforms. Problem-Solving Skills : Strong analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to identify and resolve technical challenges efficiently. Collaboration Skills : Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with experience working closely with multidisciplinary teams. Ability to balance technical and creative goals, ensuring high-quality results. Preferred Skills Familiarity with procedural tools like Houdini. Experience with visual scripting systems such as Unreal Engine’s Blueprint or Unity’s Shader Graph. Knowledge of rigging, skinning, and animation workflows. Experience in VR/AR development or real-time ray tracing technologies. Note: Specific requirements may vary depending on project needs.

b90644452fc6bea3.description: Join Salla as a Marketing Specialist through the Tamheer program, where you will gain hands-on experience and develop your skills in various aspects of marketing. As a Marketing Specialist at Salla, you will have the opportunity to specialize in one of three Roles: Social Media – driving engagement by creating and managing impactful content across various platforms. Graphic Design – developing creative and visually appealing designs to support our marketing initiatives. Copywriting/Technical Writing – delivering compelling copy and clear technical content that strengthens brand messaging. In this roles , you will play a vital part in shaping marketing strategies, executing campaigns, and analyzing performance metrics to enhance Salla’s brand presence and customer engagement. Responsibilities: Support the marketing team in developing and implementing marketing plans and campaigns. Conduct market research to identify trends, customer preferences, and competitive landscape. Assist in creating engaging content for digital platforms, including social media, blogs, and newsletters. Help manage social media accounts, including posting, scheduling, and responding to inquiries. Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics to provide actionable insights for optimization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment in marketing efforts. Participate in the planning and execution of marketing events and promotions. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in marketing. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. Strong interest in marketing with some experience or internships preferred. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing tools. Analytical skills to interpret data and make recommendations. Creative mindset with the ability to contribute innovative ideas. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment. Training & Development Bonus Work From Home

b982da2d35794d96.description: As an Oracle Database Specialist at Müller's Solutions, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and optimizing Oracle databases to ensure their performance, availability, and security. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and support database solutions that align with the business needs of our organization and clients. Responsibilities: Design and implement Oracle database solutions based on business requirements and best practices. Perform database installations, upgrades, and migrations. Create and manage database objects, including tables, views, indexes, and sequences. Monitor and optimize database performance, including query tuning, index management, and capacity planning. Implement and maintain database security controls and access privileges. Perform database backups, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures. Collaborate with development teams to design and implement efficient database schemas and data models. Troubleshoot and resolve database issues, working closely with technical teams to identify and implement solutions. Stay updated with the latest Oracle database technologies, features, and best practices. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Proven experience as an Oracle Database Specialist, with expertise in managing and optimizing Oracle databases. Proficiency in Oracle database administration tasks, including installations, upgrades, and migrations. Strong understanding of Oracle database architecture, performance optimization, and troubleshooting. Experience with database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures. Knowledge of Oracle security practices and access controls. Familiarity with SQL and PL/SQL programming languages. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
